statement: On the N0 flat-space spherical scalar-wave calibration (class sub-case AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH; fixed Minkowski, test field, no self-gravity), an independently implemented direct-variable scheme (implicit Crank-Nicolson on phi with L phi = phi_rr + (2/r) phi_r, regular-centre rule L phi(0)=6(phi_1-phi_0)/dr^2, phi(R)=0, dt=0.5 dr) reproduces the published reduced-scheme results: psi-L2 fit order 1.991437 (r0=10,sigma=1.5) and 1.985789 (r0=2,sigma=1.0, origin-excited, u(0,0)~0.54) vs published cnfd 1.993478, both inside the harness p_tol=0.3; direct and reduced psi fields agree to 3.9e-13 relative; the interior is bitwise identical (0.0 absolute difference) under four different origin rules (6/dr^2, 2/dr^2, garbage coefficients, and phi(0) pinned to 17) whose phi(0) values differ by >=16.9. The reason is algebraic: on this uniform node-centred grid r_i*(L_sph u)_i = (Delta_1D (r u))_i to 2.4e-16 relative and the first interior row's lower coefficient is exactly zero, so the psi=r*phi reduction and the origin treatment are not independent discretisation axes. Taylor-start vs exact-start orders differ by <=0.0025; the spatial order isolated from temporal error (cfl->0 intercepts at fixed dr) is 1.99974/1.99988 with linear-in-dt^2 fits R^2>=0.9999998. Published wiring check: the re-implemented cnfd reproduces the published fit order and row errors to 2.5e-15 relative. Scope limits: fixed Minkowski test field only; the structural identity is specific to this node-centred grid/operator form; artifacts are validation_status=unverified pending reviewer verdict.

statement: At published module numerics/tests/flat_wave_replication.py#8ade1cdc163e and protocol numerics/CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md#1e6cdf04d7a2, the three schemes published as methodologically independent (lffd, cnfd, cnfem) contain 2 distinct spatial discretisations and 2 distinct time integrators: the lffd and cnfd spatial operators are the same 3-point FD matrix (cnfd.self.A equals the FD matrix with max abs entry diff 0.0; random-state one-step identities pin lffd d2=A*psi to 3.70e-16 and cnfd d2=A*(psi_new+psi_old)/2 to 7.85e-16 relative), and cnfd/cnfem share the Crank-Nicolson integrator, so the published three occupy 3 of the 4 cells of a 2 (spatial: 3-point FD, P1 consistent-mass FEM) x 2 (time: leapfrog, Crank-Nicolson) design. The missing cell (FEM+leapfrog) was implemented in artifacts/worker-051/n0_scheme_axes/ and measures mixed 4-rung order 2.001045 and dt->0 isolated spatial order 1.999993; the published 4-rung orders (lffd 1.9966248643, cnfd 1.9953510344, cnfem 1.9888598802) reproduce bitwise (abs delta 0.0). FEM and FD are distinct operators, not merely differently scaled ones: central-row Nyquist implied eigenvalues are in the exact ratio 3.000000000000000 (dev <= 1.9e-16; 4/h^2 vs 12/h^2), the smooth-mode relative difference decays at fitted order 2.0000 (7.31e-5 at dr=0.2 to 1.14e-6 at dr=0.025), boundary-row relative difference is 0.8231, and the full-matrix Frobenius difference stays O(1) (boundary/grid-scale dominated, explicitly not a convergence metric). Therefore 'independence holds along spatial discretisation' holds at multiplicity 2, not 3, while the order-2 result is corroborated by a complete 2x2 design: all four cells are monotone and within |p-2|<=0.3 in both mixed and dt->0 isolated spatial order. conclusion_type numerical_evidence; flat-space calibration sub-case only.
